feature_contract.goal: Keep the moving vehicle and rival projected ordinal marker physically attached to the same Calc3D2D 3D source across both R84 shader/c64 stereo eye submissions, without borrowing a fixed 6th/6 gameplay HUD or another car's marker.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only the R84 R33 shader c64 projected car/rival physical GPU eye pair and its authoritative per-car producer/queue/pose/shader/vertex layout; exclude fixed 6th/6 ScreenHud, GOAL/+TIME, F11, lens centre, SkyGlow, input and FFB, R26 fallback, DX11 and frozen DXVK.
trace_stages: Original 0x004BAD20 vehicle marker calls Calc3D2D 0x00449940 and queues its own sprite/clip glyphs at EXE RVA 0xBB0FB..0xBB2D0.
Game per-car ProjectedMarkerInfo survives exact producer and SpriteNode replay to R30 shader/c64 stereo eye matrix selection.
R33 physical GPU owner rechecks the same marker, queue node/epoch, shader epoch, draw serial, vertex state and pose across native LEFT and RIGHT submissions; host receives only a coherent eye pair.
subcomponents: Before native LEFT verify live shader rank source and exclude unowned or ScreenHud 6th/6 and unrelated world producers, leaving stock draw when proof is missing.
After native LEFT verify exact same car marker source and fail closed before RIGHT eye, restore original c64 and flag stereo frame unhealthy upon reentrant source change.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Two physical GPU eyes of a single car-attached projected marker
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: One exact live projected vehicle or rival marker survives native left callback and is required for right eye; other car, HUD or new queue cannot inherit its precomputed c64.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Fixed ScreenHud 6th/6 and original device shader/pose restore
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Invalid queue, missing pose, FVF or shader change or unrelated native HUD must not receive the car's right eye; stock single draw remains when pre-left evidence is absent.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Windows R84 source build and host/package with mandatory guard CI
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Exact validation-bearing result SHA passes DX9Ex Active x86 game, x64 OpenXR host and package, Domain Isolation, HUD Inspector and Full Source Impact; HMD separately untested.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Read-only original executable 2026-10-18 Ghidra producer evidence: 0x004BAD20 car-attached rank 0x00449940 Calc3D2D and clip/sprani; 6th/6 is independent 0x004B9D80 screen source.
source_trace: RankMarker_Sprani/clip producer and SpriteNode preserve individual view-space anchor through render_semantics.hpp.
R30BuildScreenSpaceEyeConstants already selects original rank WVP and two asymmetric-eye constants, but does not enforce post-left source identity inside R33 shader Draw.

R33TryHud previously guarded C993, +TIME, GOAL, car shadow and native HUD across left/right but omitted ProjectedWorldMarker2D shader source stamp despite R30 XYZRHW already checking same rank helper.
diagnosis.root_cause: The physical R33 shader rank path can prepare a right-eye projection from one Calc3D2D vehicle then run a reentrant original left GPU Draw that switches the queue marker/pose/shader before the right eye is submitted; unlike R30 fixedfn/XYZRHW path, R33 lacked a before/after projected-rank owner transaction.
alternatives_rejected: Do not flatten vehicle markers into native 6th/6 ScreenHud or infer source from FVF/alpha alone.
No runtime claim: the static source identity bug is demonstrable from missing post-left check, but visible optical failure still needs matching HMD tests.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: R33 shader GPU physical rank stamp validates producer, queue node/epoch, per-vehicle marker, shader epoch, vertex layout and pose before and after original LEFT; changed owner skips RIGHT and restores original c64.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Expanded portable rank_marker_physical_source_smoke to exercise shader queued/direct success, cross-car changes, stale queue/pose, changed draw, shader, FVF and native 6th/6 rejection; exact SHA CI pending.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Two eye projections may only originate from one live per-car Calc3D2D marker, never a stale Shader c64 from another producer; failed right ownership invalidates frame for stereo publication.

notes: New real C++ rank shader physical-source repair, separate from fixed ScreenHud 6th/6 and existing XYZ/RHW/fixedfn rank routes. HMD untested, no CI completion or scoring declared.
